title: b7z9.49(b): heap-validate debug overlay + app-prj.conf decision (needs Mark)
description: Flagged-ambiguity remainder of worker6-b7z9.49: spec R-APPC-008 says CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE=y '(debug builds)' and the thread-analyzer MUST is qualified '(CI and debug builds)' — if those qualifiers scope the MUST to test/debug configs, app prj.confs (gateway/puck/bridge) are conformant as-is and the remainder is a debug overlay; if ruled unconditional, the apps need the full block. Decision needed from Mark on scope, then: create a debug overlay (e.g. lichen/boards/debug.overlay or a debug.conf snippet pattern) enabling CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE=y (+ thread analyzer if ruled broader) and wire it where CI/debug builds consume overlays. Not landable until the scope decision.
